Extracts heading hierarchy (h1-h6) from HTML page

```elixir title="Elixir"
{:ok, engine} = Crawlberg.create_engine(nil)
url = "https://example.com"
result = Crawlberg.scrape_async(engine, url)
IO.inspect(result.status_code)
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.metadata.headings, 0).level)
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.metadata.headings, 0).text)
IO.inspect(length(result.metadata.headings))
```
